admission.justification: The optional field, finalizer, completion-time model and table live separately, and their contract prevents removal of finalizer decision writes from erasing the only completion-time source or falsely presenting task-number order as recency.

applicability: Ordinary-master completed-task whole lists and newest-five previews, and the finalizer-written completion fact they consume.
conditions: A new completion writes completedAt independently of decision records; older completed documents are not rewritten.
The legacy fallback reads the exact finalizer record’s at when completedAt is absent.
The whole view opens newest first, numeric task-number and completion-time sorts are reversible and show the active direction, and unknown times are last for either time direction.
Sort choice is ephemeral; the preview shows at most five newest completed rows with number, name and time, fewer when fewer exist and none when none exist.
exclusions: Changing abandoned-list order or sprint-list order.

evidence: Parent full-source inspection on resolved RF01 plus cd2eef binding; native source case declarations remain scoped and unexecuted by Curator.

statement: Master completed-task views open newest first with reversible numeric and completion-time sorts, place unknown times last, show up to five newest rows in the master preview, and obtain completion from a finalizer-written completedAt field or a read-only legacy finalizer record.
